.pt-ui {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 24px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.pt-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.pt-meta {
  font-family: var(--pt-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.pt-meta-right {
  text-align: right;
}

.pt-meta-label {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
}

.pt-meta-val {
  color: #fff;
  display: block;
}

.pt-title-block {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.pt-title {
  font-family: var(--pt-serif);
  font-weight: 300;
  font-size: 32px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
}

.pt-subtitle {
  font-family: var(--pt-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  margin: 0;
}

.pt-transit {
  flex-grow: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  perspective: 1000px;
}

.pt-wheel {
  position: relative;
  width: 320px;
  height: 320px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.pt-ring {
  position: absolute;
  border: 1px dotted rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: 50%;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.pt-ring-1 {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.pt-ring-2 {
  width: 70%;
  height: 70%;
}

.pt-ring-3 {
  width: 40%;
  height: 40%;
}

.pt-house {
  position: absolute;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  width: 60px;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.pt-house-dot {
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.pt-house-label {
  font-family: var(--pt-serif);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pt-planet {
  position: absolute;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px #fff;
  z-index: 5;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  margin-top: -4px;
  margin-left: -4px;
  will-change: transform;
}

.pt-zenith {
  position: absolute;
  right: 12px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  height: 180px;
  width: 30px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  z-index: 100;
}

.pt-zenith-line {
  width: 1px;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    transparent,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15),
    transparent
  );
  position: absolute;
  left: 15px;
  z-index: -1;
}

.pt-zenith-node {
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.pt-zenith-node-active {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(2.5);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px white;
}

.pt-details {
  border-top: 1px dotted rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  padding-top: 20px;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.pt-detail-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.pt-detail-label {
  font-family: var(--pt-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
}

.pt-detail-val {
  font-family: var(--pt-serif);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.pt-stream {
  position: absolute;
  left: 24px;
  bottom: 24px;
  font-family: var(--pt-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  line-height: 1.6;
}
EOF

  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, #082f49 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, #0f172a 0%, transparent 50%);
  filter: blur(60px);
}

.eih-grid-floor {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -50%;
  left: -50%;
  width: 200%;
  height: 200%;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 40px 40px;
  transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(75deg);
  z-index: 0;
  opacity: 0.3;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.eih-stage {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  perspective: 2000px;
}

.eih-card-cluster {
  position: absolute;
  width: 600px;
  height: 400px;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.eih-stage:hover .eih-card-cluster {
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.eih-template-card {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 280px;
  height: 380px;
  margin-top: -190px;
  margin-left: -140px;
  background: var(--eih-glass-bg);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%);
  border-radius: 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--eih-glass-border-light);
  border-bottom-color: var(--eih-glass-border-dark);
  border-right-color: var(--eih-glass-border-dark);
  box-shadow:
    var(--eih-glass-shadow),
    inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05),
    inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  transition: all 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  transform-origin: center bottom;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 24px;
  cursor: pointer;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, 40px, -100px) scale(0.9);
}

.eih-card-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.2);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: auto;
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.eih-card-icon svg {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  stroke: var(--eih-energy);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  fill: none;
}

.eih-card-meta {
  font-family: var(--eih-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--eih-muted);
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.eih-card-title {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;idle&#39;] .eih-template-card:nth-child(1) {
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, -60px) rotate(-4deg);
  opacity: 0.4;
}
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;idle&#39;] .eih-template-card:nth-child(2) {
  transform: translate3d(0, 10px, -30px) rotate(2deg);
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;idle&#39;] .eih-template-card:nth-child(3) {
  transform: translate3d(0, 20px, 0) rotate(-1deg);
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;idle&#39;]:hover .eih-template-card:nth-child(1) {
  transform: translate3d(-220px, -20px, 0) rotate(-12deg);
  opacity: 1;
}
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;idle&#39;]:hover .eih-template-card:nth-child(2) {
  transform: translate3d(0, -40px, 40px) rotate(0deg);
  opacity: 1;
}
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;idle&#39;]:hover .eih-template-card:nth-child(3) {
  transform: translate3d(220px, -10px, 0) rotate(10deg);
  opacity: 1;
}

.eih-template-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--eih-energy);
  box-shadow:
    0 32px 64px -12px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.2),
    inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.eih-input-hub {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  width: min(680px, calc(100% - 32px));
  transition:
    transform 0.4s ease,
    opacity 0.4s ease;
}

.eih-glass-panel {
  background: var(--eih-glass-bg);
  backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(180%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(180%);
  border-radius: 32px;
  border: 1px solid var(--eih-glass-border-light);
  border-bottom-color: var(--eih-glass-border-dark);
  border-right-color: var(--eih-glass-border-dark);
  box-shadow:
    0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
    inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05),
    inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  padding: 8px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.eih-sys-labels {
  position: absolute;
  top: 24px;
  left: 32px;
  right: 32px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

.eih-sys-label {
  font-family: var(--eih-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--eih-muted);
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.eih-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  height: 180px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  resize: none;
  padding: 56px 32px 32px;
  font-family: var(--eih-sans);
  font-size: 24px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--eih-text);
  outline: none;
  z-index: 1;
  position: relative;
}

.eih-textarea::placeholder {
  color: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.4);
}

.eih-controls {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 16px 16px 24px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.eih-tools {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}

.eih-tool-btn {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  padding: 0;
}

.eih-tool-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
}

.eih-tool-btn svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  stroke: var(--eih-muted);
  stroke-width: 2;
  fill: none;
}

.eih-generate {
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  width: 140px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
    0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.eih-btn-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 4px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, var(--eih-energy) 0%, var(--eih-energy-dark) 100%);
  opacity: 0.1;
  transition:
    opacity 0.4s ease,
    filter 0.4s ease;
  filter: blur(4px);
}

.eih-btn-cap {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9));
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  transition: transform 0.1s;
}

.eih-btn-text {
  font-family: var(--eih-sans);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: var(--eih-energy);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.eih-textarea:focus ~ .eih-controls .eih-generate .eih-btn-core,
.eih-generate:hover .eih-btn-core {
  opacity: 1;
  filter: blur(8px);
}

.eih-generate:hover .eih-btn-text {
  color: #fff;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--eih-energy);
}

.eih-generate:active .eih-btn-cap {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}

.eih-particle-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 100;
  opacity: 0;
}

.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;animating&#39;] .eih-textarea {
  color: transparent;
}
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;animating&#39;] .eih-input-hub {
  transform: scale(0.95);
  opacity: 0.8;
  filter: blur(2px);
}
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;animating&#39;] .eih-particle-canvas {
  opacity: 1;
}

.eih-generated-doc {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 5;
  padding: 40px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}

.eih-skel {
  background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1);
}
.eih-skel-header {
  height: 40px;
  width: 60%;
}
.eih-skel-body {
  height: 120px;
  width: 100%;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;resolved&#39;] .eih-generated-doc {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transition: opacity 1s ease 0.5s;
}
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;resolved&#39;] .eih-textarea,
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;resolved&#39;] .eih-controls,
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;resolved&#39;] .eih-sys-labels {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.eih-stage[data-state=&#39;resolved&#39;] .eih-glass-panel {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 80px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.15),
    inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-color: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3);
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .eih-card-cluster {
    display: none;
  }
}
EOF
# Fix the typo I introduced with &#34;and 0.2&#34;

  apps/app/src/components/design-system/lab-prototypes/energy-input-hub/energy-input-hub.css
wc -l apps/app/src/components/design-system/lab-prototypes/energy-input-hub/energy-input-hub.css

.eih-textarea::placeholder {

  display: flex;

  padding: 0 16px 16px 24px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.eih-tools {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}

.eih-tool-btn {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  padding: 0;
}

.eih-tool-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);

}

.eih-tool-btn svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  stroke: var(--eih-muted);
  stroke-width: 2;
  fill: none;
}

.eih-generate {
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  width: 140px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
    0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.eih-btn-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 4px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, var(--eih-energy) 0%, var(--eih-energy-dark) 100%);
  opacity: 0.1;
  transition:
    opacity 0.4s ease,
    filter 0.4s ease;
  filter: blur(4px);
}

.eih-btn-cap {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9));
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  transition: transform 0.1s;
}

.eih-btn-text {
  font-family: var(--eih-sans);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: var(--eih-energy);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.eih-textarea:focus ~ .eih-controls .eih-generate .eih-btn-core,
.eih-generate:hover .eih-btn-core {
  opacity: 1;

}

}

.eih-generate:active .eih-btn-cap {

}

.eih-stage[data-state='idle']:hover .eih-template-card:nth-child(1) {
  transform: translate3d(-220px, -20px, 0) rotate(-12deg);
  opacity: 1;
}
.eih-stage[data-state='idle']:hover .eih-template-card:nth-child(2) {
  transform: translate3d(0, -40px, 40px) rotate(0deg);
  opacity: 1;
}
.eih-stage[data-state='idle']:hover .eih-template-card:nth-child(3) {
  transform: translate3d(220px, -10px, 0) rotate(10deg);
  opacity: 1;
}

.eih-template-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--eih-energy);
  box-shadow:
    0 32px 64px -12px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.2),
    inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.eih-input-hub {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  width: min(680px, calc(100% - 32px));
  transition:
    transform 0.4s ease,
    opacity 0.4s ease;
}

.eih-glass-panel {
  background: var(--eih-glass-bg);
  backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(180%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(180%);
  border-radius: 32px;
  border: 1px solid var(--eih-glass-border-light);
  border-bottom-color: var(--eih-glass-border-dark);
  border-right-color: var(--eih-glass-border-dark);
  box-shadow:
    0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
    inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05),
    inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  padding: 8px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.eih-sys-labels {
  position: absolute;
  top: 24px;
  left: 32px;
  right: 32px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

.eih-sys-label {
  font-family: var(--eih-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--eih-muted);
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.eih-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  height: 180px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  resize: none;
  padding: 56px 32px 32px;
  font-family: var(--eih-sans);
  font-size: 24px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--eih-text);
  outline: none;
  z-index: 1;
  position: relative;
}

.eih-textarea::placeholder {
  color: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.4);
}

.eih-controls {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 16px 16px 24px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.eih-tools {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}

.eih-tool-btn {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  padding: 0;
}

.eih-tool-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
}

.eih-tool-btn svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  stroke: var(--eih-muted);
  stroke-width: 2;
  fill: none;
}

.eih-generate {
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  width: 140px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
    0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.eih-btn-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 4px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, var(--eih-energy) 0%, var(--eih-energy-dark) 100%);
  opacity: 0.1;
  transition:
    opacity 0.4s ease,
    filter 0.4s ease;
  filter: blur(4px);
}

.eih-btn-cap {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9));
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  transition: transform 0.1s;
}

.eih-btn-text {
  font-family: var(--eih-sans);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: var(--eih-energy);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.eih-textarea:focus ~ .eih-controls .eih-generate .eih-btn-core,
.eih-generate:hover .eih-btn-core {
  opacity: 1;
  filter: blur(8px);
}

.eih-generate:hover .eih-btn-text {
  color: #fff;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--eih-energy);
}

.eih-generate:active .eih-btn-cap {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}

.eih-particle-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 100;
  opacity: 0;
}

.eih-stage[data-state='animating'] .eih-textarea {
  color: transparent;
}
.eih-stage[data-state='animating'] .eih-input-hub {
  transform: scale(0.95);
  opacity: 0.8;
  filter: blur(2px);
}
.eih-stage[data-state='animating'] .eih-particle-canvas {
  opacity: 1;
}

.eih-generated-doc {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 5;
  padding: 40px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}

.eih-skel {
  background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1);
}
.eih-skel-header {
  height: 40px;
  width: 60%;
}
.eih-skel-body {
  height: 120px;
  width: 100%;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.eih-stage[data-state='resolved'] .eih-generated-doc {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transition: opacity 1s ease 0.5s;
}
.eih-stage[data-state='resolved'] .eih-textarea,
.eih-stage[data-state='resolved'] .eih-controls,
.eih-stage[data-state='resolved'] .eih-sys-labels {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.eih-stage[data-state='resolved'] .eih-glass-panel {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 80px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.15),
    inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-color: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3);
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .eih-card-cluster {
    display: none;
  }
}
